article_title: Where Hotel Websites Lose Direct Bookings Before Checkout

reader.job_to_be_done: Trace a hotel guest from organic landing to a reconciled direct booking and prioritize the first verified leak.

visuals.reader_question: Where can the direct-booking journey leak?
visuals.teaches: Three leakage zones across search, property evaluation, handoff and checkout.
visuals.placement: After direct answer and reader contract.
visuals.alt: Hotel direct-booking journey connecting search, property evaluation, availability and payment.
visuals.caption: End-to-end direct-booking audit model.

visuals.reader_question: What must remain intact between the hotel domain and booking engine?
visuals.teaches: Same stream, retained linker and no acquisition overwrite.
visuals.exact_state: Two domains connected with _gl and three verification checks.
visuals.alt: Hotel site and external booking engine connected with GA4 cross-domain measurement.
visuals.caption: Simplified architecture based on current Google documentation.

visuals.reader_question: Which event proves a booking rather than an attempted checkout?
visuals.teaches: Selection, checkout, payment and purchase event separation.
visuals.alt: Four GA4 hotel events from room selection to confirmed purchase.
visuals.caption: Recommended ecommerce vocabulary adapted to a hotel flow.

visuals.reader_question: Which device cohort has the largest verified booking opportunity?
visuals.teaches: Segmented cohort analysis with explicit fictional-data disclosure.
visuals.exact_state: Mobile, desktop and tablet landings through purchase.
visuals.placement: After the complete modeled hotel example.
visuals.alt: Modeled hotel booking cohort segmented by device.
visuals.caption: Fictional training data, not a benchmark or client claim.

visuals.reader_question: What must be true before the hotel accepts the audit result?
visuals.teaches: Six acceptance checks ending in revenue-team reconciliation.
visuals.exact_state: Completed acceptance board for search, page, handoff, rate, booking and human review.
visuals.alt: Hotel direct-booking acceptance board with six verification checks.
visuals.caption: Publication and implementation QA board.
